questions_append.topic: Part Lifecycle: who can open Parts → Returns and start a vendor return today
questions_append.question: The spec now says opening Parts → Returns and starting a vendor return "keep the access today's 'Vendor Order Management' settings give" (S9-N3a), without naming that access. So the tests compare the build with production. Please state today's access so the tests can say it directly: (a) Can a role with no Vendor Order Management permission open Parts → Returns? (b) Can a role with Vendor Order Management → View, but not Create & Edit, start a vendor return? (c) Which role, if any, reaches a return's or a vendor credit's part search without Part Library & Inventory → View, so the standard access error of S9-N3 can be seen? (Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit includes Part Library & Inventory → View, S9-N3a.)
questions_append.options:
(a) A) Yes. B) No.
(b) A) Yes. B) No, the button is hidden. C) No, it is greyed out.
(c) A) A role with Vendor Order Management → View only. B) No role on screen today (the error is reached only outside the screens).
sources: Jira SV-10822, Nemanja Djuric and Chris Ward, 23 Oct 2026
questions_append.note: Not held: S9-41 and S9-42 run today as a side-by-side comparison with production (S12-N1: every user's access on release day is identical to the day before). If the answer to (c) is B, S9-N3's access error is a NO MANUAL CASE.

questions_append.topic: Part Lifecycle: renaming a part to a look-alike of another part at the same location
questions_append.question: A part's number is changed, in Edit Inventory Part, to one that matches another part at the SAME location once case and punctuation are ignored (for example AB-100 is stocked here and another part is renamed to ab 100). Story 7 says the save is refused with "AB-100 already exists at this location." (S7-N3, S7-N5b). The new S13-N1a refuses a rename that matches a part "at any location that stocks this part" with "AB-100 already exists at Staging Heavy Duty." ("{existing part number} already exists at {location}."). Which message shows when the look-alike is at this same location?
questions_append.options:
A) Story 7's: "AB-100 already exists at this location."
B) S13-N1a's: "AB-100 already exists at <this location's name>."
